title: Age-specific Prevalence and Comparisons of UDS and Bladder Diary Between OAB-wet and -Dry Women
brief_summary: The knowledge of the age-specific prevalence of overactive bladder syndrome (OAB)-wet and -dry women is important for understanding the impact of aging on OAB. Thus, our aim is to describe clinically differences between OAB-wet and -dry women.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. More than 20-year-old
2. Female
3. Diagnosed with overactive bladder by bladder diary

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Younger than 20-year-old
2. Pregnant or planned to be pregnant
study_population: Between July 2009 and January 2018, all women older than 20-year-old with OAB visiting a medical center for evaluation were enrolled.
